name: d-bond-local-control
description: Configure D-Bond connection SOPs and inspect event traces through the owner-only local socket.

interface.longDescription: Inspect local connections, configure ordered per-connection SOP rules with version checks, and trace event states through D-Bond's same-user Unix socket. Separate from D-Bond for Dot messaging.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my D-Bond connections and help configure a connection's SOP.
